decision_note: This script NEVER promotes automatically. Production artifacts unchanged.
ranking_rule: highest external phishing recall, then highest domain recall, then lowest domain FPR

phishing_database_stratified_sample.method: primary strata (path, query, suspicious_tld, ip_host, suspicious_token, percent_encoding) with proportional largest-remainder allocation + low-signal boost; systematic sampling inside each stratum over fine dimensions

ablation_experiment.note: Reduced-complexity variant for ablation comparison only. If reduced variant degrades recall, the production feature set (all 29) is preferred.

thresholds.selection_rule: maximize phishing recall subject to threshold-split FPR <= 2.0%

google_search_not_phishing.requirement: no Google search URL classified PHISHING

youtube_query_not_phishing.requirement: YouTube query URL not classified PHISHING

no_domain_allowlist.requirement: no domain allowlist or score bypass in model
no_domain_allowlist.actual: verified: model uses normal inference only

production_hashes_unchanged.requirement: SHA-256 of production artifacts identical before and after
